summary.plain: China's national laboratory for particle physics, in Beijing and part of the Chinese Academy of Sciences. It built and runs the Beijing Electron-Positron Collider, whose BES detectors study the tau lepton and charm physics.
summary.technical: IHEP, established February 1973 from Division One of the Institute of Atomic Energy; main campus on Yuquan Road, Beijing, home of BEPC/BEPCII (e⁺e⁻, 2.0-4.2 GeV tau-charm region) with the BESIII detector and the BSRF.
